pool.text: York Castle was the site of an infamous massacre of Jewish inhabitants.
King John granted the city's first charter confirming trading rights.
The city acquired privileges granted by a charter of Richard II.
The Parliamentarians besieged York during the English Civil War.
The city's first hospital opened in Monkgate funded by public subscription.
George Hudson was responsible for bringing the railway to the city.
A new library building was erected on Museum Street.
Bettys founder Frederick Belmont travelled on the maiden voyage of the Queen Mary.
The city was bombed during the Second World War by the Luftwaffe.
The opening of the University of York added to city prosperity.
The historic core of York was designated a conservation area.
The National Railway Museum was established in the city.
The Jorvik Viking Centre opened as a tourist attraction.
The York Dungeon opened as a tourist attraction.
Terry's chocolate factory closed when production moved to Poland.
Nestlé announced that it would cut 645 jobs at the factory.
York was voted European Tourism City of the Year.
York was voted safest place to visit in the awards.
York's Chocolate Story opened its doors in March.
The current Council Leader was appointed following the local election.
